## Checklist

- [ ] One file per entry, `packages/<id>.toml`, with the id built from the repository's owner and name
- [ ] The description is in my own words, not pasted from the project's README or GitHub description
- [ ] No tags, stars, dates or license written by hand (the bot fetches them)
- [ ] `README.md` and `index.json` are not edited (they are generated after merge)
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally
